overview: The military-political leadership of the Resistance, coordinating cells, fleet assets, and intelligence operations against the First Order without Senate backing.
history: Resistance High Command governed galactic affairs during the Resistance. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Resistance High Command shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Resistance High Command established as a governing authority in galactic records
Institutional powers and succession rules documented across chronicle eras

timeline.event: Resistance High Command enters the historical record
